messages.subject: Vocalization with many Syllables: analyses
parts:
Dear All, 

 I have some vocalizations with many syllables and I would like to measures the frequencies or duration of each syllable, for example, frequency start or duration of each syllables. I just wondering if there is a way (scripts) or package that I can use to measure parameters of each syllable at the same time, instead of repeating passages for each. Is there a way?
Sometimes I have vocalizations with 60 syllables...So I just wondering if there is a quick way to calculate syllables acoustic or temporal parameters with r.

thank you 
best wishes 
Rosaria
